facts.fact: AGEFAU itself reports that its board adopted a revised 2026 budget of FCFA 27,886,688,000 against FCFA 41,151,471,000 initially, a fall of 32% within the same budget year, with projects spread over 2026 and 2027; this is not a comparison of two budget years.
The fund agency's revised 2026 budget pays for network extension in 162 localities, 80 universal access centres, 100 Wi-Fi huts, school computer rooms and training of 1,000 young people.
